properties.name: entrovouch:scopeStatement
properties.value: Software Bill of Materials from declared top-level dependencies in pyproject.toml, requirements*.txt, setup.cfg and package.json. Generation context: pre-build (source manifests). Transitive dependencies are NOT enumerated. Component hashes of executable artifacts are UNKNOWN — this tool does not see a build. Licenses and component producers are UNKNOWN unless present in the declaration, which they almost never are. npm devDependencies are omitted. package-lock.json / poetry.lock / uv.lock are not read (a lockfile is a resolved graph; this pass is the declaration). CISA 2026 Minimum Elements conformance is NOT CLAIMED. Unknown fields are labelled unknown-to-author, not withheld.

properties.name: entrovouch:cisa2026MinimumElements
properties.value: NOT CLAIMED — source-manifest SBOM; component hashes, transitive coverage and licenses are labelled unknown rather than filled

properties.name: entrovouch:unknownFields
properties.value: component-hash (no executable artifact); component-license; component-producer; transitive-dependencies; component-version (declared as a range, not a pin)
